race.comment: Very good race with a few last start winners and several coming off breaks and forgive runs. CATTLE CAMP (1) was well fancied fresh and found the line well enough but peaked on condition, as reported to stewards by jockey Luke Nolen. Fitter and blinkers added for this. Drawn for a soft run and will be hard to hold out. OUR YONGLEE (6) was a debut winner storming home to score in the autumn then given a break since. Fitter for two trials. ROYAL RENDEZVOUS (2) returned form a long spell with a midfield finish and given a freshen since. Extra ground suits and expected to improve sharply. LAGUNANINI (12) also resumes form a long break. Speedy filly outclassed last two, the latest in stakes class. Resumes back in right grade.
